items.description: Add new column between title and location - Event date.  Default sort should be on date, listing the soonest event at the top.
On mobile, users are able to sort by relevance.  Please omit this option on the drop down menu - we are not using relevance on this site.

When searching for an event that is not found, the interface refers to "jobs" instead of "events": use Events
